State-of-the-Art Equipment

Powered by Industry-Leading Technology

From high-speed fiber laser cutting and 33-ton automated punching to 5-axis capable CNC milling centers and calibrated CMM inspection, our facility is equipped to handle complex aerospace, medical, and electronics production without outsourcing.

Laser Technology

Amada 4kW High-Power Fiber Laser Cutting System

4,000 Watt Resonator | 5ft x 10ft Dual Automated Pallet Shuttle Bed

Delivers ultra-high-speed, burr-free cutting on stainless steel, aluminum, copper, brass, and carbon steel. Features advanced optics and nitrogen assist cutting for oxidized-free edges ready for immediate welding or plating.

Machine Highlights
  • High cutting speed on thin-to-medium gauge metals
  • Automatic sheet loader reducing cycle turnaround
  • Precision micro-joints preserving delicate profiles
  • Clean edge quality minimizing secondary deburring
Punching & Forming

Amada CNC Turret Punch Presses

33-Ton Punching Force | 58-Station Thick Turret with 4 Auto-Index Stations

Equipped with progressive multi-station tooling for high-speed perforation, punching, tapping, countersinking, and forming louvers in a single automated pass.

Machine Highlights
  • High hit rate for perforated sheet patterns and electronics ventilation
  • In-machine tapping eliminating secondary manual threading
  • Extrusion and louver forming capability
  • Automated tool lubrication for extended die life
Forming & Bending

Amada Precision Multi-Axis CNC Press Brakes

Up to 150-Ton Capacity | 10-Foot Bed Length | 8-Axis Programmable Backgauge

Computer-controlled linear scale feedback and crowning compensation systems ensuring repeatable, precision angular bends across complex production runs.

Machine Highlights
  • Digital angle sensor compensation for material spring-back
  • Extensive European precision-ground punch and die tooling library
  • Multi-stage bend configurations in a single operator setup
  • Deep box forming and tight radius capabilities
Fastener Insertion

Haeger Automatic Hardware Insertion Presses

6-Ton & 8-Ton Hydraulic Pressure | Autofeed Vibratory Bowl Feeders

High-speed automated insertion of threaded PEM studs, standoffs, nuts, and access hardware with programmable insertion force monitoring.

Machine Highlights
  • Positive stop technology ensuring consistent flush seating
  • Safety-monitored tooling eliminating fastener distortion
  • Batch counting to ensure 100% fastener count compliance
